purpose: Master specification for application architecture, specification ownership, and implementation contracts.

source_of_truth.blueprint.json: Master architecture, document map, and cross-document rules.
source_of_truth.App.json: Application composition, routing, page definitions, and overlay placement.
source_of_truth.design_system.json: Design tokens, visual rules, and reusable UI styling.

pageHost.rule: Render only the page matched by the current route.

globalRules: React Router determines the active page.
PageHost renders one route-matched page at a time.
AppShell pages and StandalonePages use separate layout routes.
StandalonePages must not render AppShell AppHeader or BottomNavigation.
OverlayHost is global and is not nested inside an individual page layout.
MainContent and StandaloneContent must be allowed to shrink and scroll vertically.
Do not treat a specification as implemented until the corresponding code is present and verified.
validation: App.json and design_system.json do not contradict this blueprint.
Every route resolves to the correct layout group.
Only one route page is active in PageHost.
Standalone pages do not inherit AppShell navigation.
